name: chorus
description: LFO-modulated short delay mixed with the dry signal

params.name: rate
params.doc: LFO frequency. Stored in centi-hertz: 100 = 1.00 Hz.

params.name: depth
params.doc: Peak sweep either side of base_ms. Stored in 0.01 ms steps.

params.name: base_ms
params.doc: Centre delay. Stored in 0.1 ms steps; capped at 30 ms, beyond which it stops being a chorus and the buffer grows.
